obligations.description: Result should remain non-negative under validated inputs

assumptions.description: Sender balance must be non-negative before any transfer operation
assumptions.justification: Account balances cannot be negative at rest; enforced by account creation and prior transaction settlement policies

assumptions.description: Transfer amount must be a non-negative integer; negative amounts would represent reverse transfers and are disallowed
assumptions.justification: Transfer API schema requires amount to be a non-negative integer field; negative values are rejected at the API boundary
